# Cocoar UI — AI Quickstart (llms.txt)

This repository contains the Cocoar (Coar) design system for Angular.

If you are an AI assistant (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and need to help a developer build UI with Coar, start here:

1) Read architecture + naming rules:
- ARCHITECTURE.md
- NAMING.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md

2) Consumer setup (how to use packages in an app):
- docs/consuming/angular.md

3) Component reference (authoritative public API):
- docs/reference/ui-components.api.json
- docs/reference/ui-components.md

4) Recipes (copy/paste patterns):
- docs/recipes/forms-status.md
- docs/recipes/login-form-skeleton.md

Notes:
- Components are layout-agnostic (apps control spacing).
- Styling is via CSS variables from @cocoar/ui-tokens.
- Form controls integration (ControlValueAccessor) exists for: coar-text-input, coar-password-input, coar-number-input, coar-checkbox.
- Signal Forms (Angular 21+) are NOT implemented yet (see recipes).
